RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 55

The panel's composition is weak evidence on its own — all-male panels are common and don't prove bias. Lead instead with the qualification comparison, which is your strongest point: you hold a master's in educational leadership and five years of actual leadership; he holds unspecified "courses" and classroom experience only. Where a demonstrably better-qualified woman loses to a less-qualified man without explanation, many equality statutes shift the burden onto the employer to justify the choice.

So: mention the panel as context, not as your argument. First, send a written follow-up citing your legal right to a reasoned decision and a deadline. Their answer — or continued silence — will tell you much more than the panel's makeup does.
